marta: quick ping — PR #2762 is blocked by format CI. It looks like a gofumpt diff on a generated/vendored file and a tiny import ordering change. Can someone with merge rights either re-run CI or own a 1-line style fix? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2762 :pray:
kevin: on it
kevin: checked the job — failing on storage/kv_cache/handler.go: import grouping only, nothing functional
arjun: if it's just order i can push a tiny tidy commit. who is the owner for kv_cache? @sam?
sam: i own that area. happy to accept a followup fix — prefer not to change the PR author's generated file. if CI is flaky, a rerun is fine too
ci-bot: rerun requested by @kevin — queued (job id: 8472)
marta: plan: if rerun passes we merge. if it fails with same gofumpt diff, @arjun please push a 1-line commit to align imports and i'll rebase the PR afterwards
arjun: pushing the tiny import reorder now
arjun: commit message: "style: reorder imports in kv_cache handler to satisfy gofumpt"
arjun: diff:
```diff
- import ("fmt" "context")
+ import (
+  "context"
+  "fmt"
+ )
```
sam: lgtm from module owner
kevin: LGTM — thanks @arjun
ci-bot: job succeeded (8472)
marta: merged — thanks everyone :tada:
kevin: nice, that was quick :thumbsup:
arjun: np, keeping PRs focused is nice
sam: small note for followups: if generated files change we should add a short note in the PR body explaining why the generator output differs, prevents confusion later
marta: good call — i'll add that to the PR template checklist
